purpose: Non-destructive byte-preserving backup of Docker Desktop WSL2 disks before any Docker/WSL recovery operation
directive: Perform ONLY the minimum safe recovery and data-preservation phase; no source code changes; no migration

pre_backup_checks.vhdx_lock_check: docker_data.vhdx OPENABLE (not locked) with Docker Desktop UI processes running but engine dead and distro Stopped

wsl_state.wsl_version_output: WSL 3.0.1.0 / kernel 6.18.40.1-1 -- clean, no 'finishing an upgrade' message

pre_backup_checks.chosen_drive: G (only drive with comfortable headroom for 18.27 GB; source already on G)

operations_not_performed: no delete, reset, prune, uninstall, recreate, or factory-reset of Docker/WSL
no Lane A / discovery / paper_trading modification
no CanonicalDecisionAuthority or Python decision authority modification
no reports overwritten (this is a new file)
no schema changes, no migrations, no writes to PostgreSQL
next_steps_pending_hash: if docker_data.vhdx hash MATCHES: wsl --shutdown, then start Docker Desktop, wait for engine
docker ps -a, inspect ahos_postgres_win / ahos_runtime_win / ahos_n8n_win
read-only Postgres verification: pg_isready, table count, ahos_chat_messages count
pg_dump of AHOS chat data if healthy
